solutions.latex:
$X$ can start once $C$ and $D$ are both finished: the earliest start time there is $8$ hours ($B$ then $D$: $2+6$).

It must finish by the latest start time of $H$, which is $13-2=11$ hours, so its latest start time is $11-2=9$ hours.
$$\therefore\ X \text{ runs from the node where } C \text{ and } D \text{ end to the node where } F \text{ ends (the start of } H\text{), parallel to } F$$

6550.stem:
The network diagram shows tasks that must be completed to finish a project. Each edge weight represents the time taken to complete the task, in days.

\exfigure{819_q32_1}

figures.cap: project activity network A to K

parts.latex: What is the earliest start time (EST) of activity $H$?
What is minimum completion time for the project?
What is the critical path for the project?
What is the float time of activity $E$?

solutions.latex:
Activity $H$ starts after $E$, $F$ and $G$ are all finished, so its EST is the longest of the paths into the node where they meet.
$$\begin{aligned} A,F &: 3+7=10 \\ B,E &: 2+5=7 \\ B,C,D,G &: 2+4+3+5=14 \end{aligned}$$
The longest is 14 days.
$$\therefore\ \text{EST of } H = 14 \text{ days}$$
criteria: Finds the length of at least two paths into the start of $H$, or equivalent merit

meta.self_check: Checked all three paths into node before H.

solutions.latex:
After $H$ and $I$, $J$, the finish of the project needs $K$. The activity $K$ starts when both $H$ and $J$ are complete.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{via } H &: 14+4=18 \\ \text{via } I,J &: 14+2+4=20 \end{aligned}$$
So $K$ starts at day 20 and takes 3 days.
$$\therefore\ \text{minimum completion time} = 20+3 = 23 \text{ days}$$

The critical path is the longest path from start to finish, with length 23 days.

The longest route to the node before $H$ and $I$ is $B,C,D,G$ (14 days). After that, $I,J$ (6 days) is longer than $H$ (4 days).
$$\begin{aligned} B+C+D+G+I+J+K &= 2+4+3+5+2+4+3 \\ &= 23 \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{critical path: } B,C,D,G,I,J,K$$
criteria: Identifies a path of length 23 incompletely, or finds the longest route to the node before $H$, or equivalent merit

meta.self_check: Sum of path = 23 = minimum completion time.

solutions.latex:
Float time $=$ LST $-$ EST, or equivalently (latest finish) $-$ (EST) $-$ (duration).

$E$ starts after $B$, so its EST is 2 days. It must finish by day 14, the EST of $H$ and $I$ (the critical path reaches that node at day 14).
$$\begin{aligned} \text{float} &= 14-2-5 \\ &= 7 \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{float time of } E = 7 \text{ days}$$
